tagline: A shared time budget for study groups
brief: Study groups try to keep each other off their phones, but limits are solitary and asking for more time means explaining yourself. Weave gives the group a shared time budget: going over costs everyone a little, and your reason stays private unless you choose to share.
criteria: Success: says 'together' without people clip-art, avoids the clock/hourglass/lock clichés of screen-time apps, matches the app icon, works in one colour and at 16 px.

concepts.name: Woven Rings
concepts.idea: Three rings, each over one and under the next: no one carries the group alone.
rationale: Borromean weave: remove any one ring and the other two fall apart, which is the group
Mint, periwinkle and peach come straight from WeaveTheme; one ring per member
Same geometry as the app icon, generated by one script
Custom-drawn heavy wordmark matches the app's heavy SF Pro UI without using SF Pro

recommendation: Woven Rings: the clearest single idea, distinct from every screen-time cliché, and already the app icon.
